desc: Ideation: reachable strings = all ordered DFS encodings of the same unordered rooted forest; count = product over nodes (incl. artificial root) of multinomial over child-isomorphism-type frequencies.

Implement the program: read input, build forest + artificial root via stack, precompute factorials up to N mod 998244353, compute canonical child-ID-sorted IDs bottom-up with an interning dict, multiply multinomials, print result.
Run against sample 1 ("(())()" -> 2) and sample 2 ("()" -> 1); confirmed exact expected outputs.
Verify the formula by hand on additional small cases ("()()" -> 1, "(()())" -> 1, "(()(()))" -> 2, "(()())()" -> 2), all consistent with the multinomial product.
Check performance for worst-case N=5000 (deep nesting and flat): algorithm is O(N log N) time, O(N) memory, no blowup.
